crossRefs.note: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself…
The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.
On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he…
By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.
Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by…
“Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will,
Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons…
‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.
For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether…
His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
translations.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
translations.asv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh even until now, and I work.
